open_points.text: “the fresh approval above is requested before the derivation” contradicts A14 rule 5: “then derives every run that has not ended … and advances, as the kernel actor, every run that derivation leaves running”
open_points.question: At start-up, is the fresh approval requested before deriving the run, or only by advancing a run after derivation leaves it running?
options: Request the fresh approval before derivation
Derive first and request it only during the subsequent advance
Change the derivation so this element makes the run running, then advance it
open_points.default_guess: Change the derivation so the unresolved work makes the run running, then let the normal advance request the approval.

open_points.subject: selection of operation elements reached before recovery derivation
open_points.text: “the fresh approval above is requested before the derivation” while `run_graph` owns “which nodes are ready and the next one by the smallest `node_id`, with its elements in list order” and `runs` “Must not own … which element is reached next”
open_points.question: Which module selects and orders fresh-approval elements reached before derivation, especially when several elements need fresh approvals or other nodes are ready?
options: `run_graph` returns those elements in normal node and element order
`runs` performs a recovery-specific selection and order
open_points.default_guess: Have `run_graph` select them using the normal smallest-node and element-order rules, with `runs` only orchestrating the calls.
